title: Customer-reported G70 experiences
summary: This topic groups brief customer-reported statements that include praise for comfort, styling, technology, and visibility, complaints about specific controls and navigation, and many incomplete snippets without clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise overall ownership experience, in-car technology, appearance, comfort, and headlight visibility.

negative.summary: Negative reviews cite dissatisfaction with the missing MSA off button and problems using navigation, with limited examples beyond those issues.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews are mostly incomplete or context-only statements that mention situations such as purchase timing, car washes, tire detection, climate use, or entering the car without enough detail to judge sentiment.

limitations: A large share of the sampled fragments are incomplete and do not provide enough context to determine sentiment.
The topic is broad and loosely tied together by the phrasing 'customer reported' rather than one clearly defined vehicle issue or feature.
Negative examples are sparse, so the complaint summary is limited to the specific issues shown in the supplied fragments.
